'''Treimar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] businessman from [[Kabaira]]. By [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], he often played [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] with his friends [[Tere Metallo]], [[Menise]], [[Branak]] and [[Del Hunter]] in [[Drayhar's Cantina]].<ref name="Passages" />
